items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: So, finally, this same office, Stevens and [With] called me

ctx.x: why don't you register?" I said, all right, maybe I will. He said, I'll drive you out. He had a car. We got up the next morning, I went out to the University of Detroit, I applied, they took me and I went to -- I started school. College. AT the University of Detroit. And I was -- I had three 8:00 o'clock classes. A week and worked in a ballroom till 1:00. Everynight. Besides studying, doing rehearsals, used to do all these things.
So, finally, this same office, Stevens and [With] called me and said, how's it going. I said, well I don't know. I'd call up Tiboo and said, boy, that's a rough -- End of Reel I
Now where we broke off there -- ah,
